tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// sgrub brgyud karma kaṃ tshang pa'i phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor sogs kyi ngag 'don 'phags lam bgrod pa'i shing rta zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

00000000dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang dbang rigs kun khyab bdag bla ma karma pa// dkyil 'khor kun gyi 'byung gnas srid zhi'i dpal gyur yi dam rnal 'byor ma// phrin las kun gyi byed por dbang bsgyur chos skyong ber can lcam dral la// rnal 'byor rtse gcig gus pas 'dud do 'bral med thugs rjes skyong bar mdzod// sgrub brgyud rin po che yi lam srol las// byung ba'i byin rlabs chu bo'i rgyun chen po// bdag gis bshes gnyen mang la bsten byas te// nyams su blangs nas byang chub sems bskyed phyir// rdo rje'i gsung rnams gsal bkod pas// 'phags lam bgrod pa'i shing rta mchog /lam 'dir zhugs pa'i skal ldan rnams// ma yengs brtson 'grus ldan par mdzod/ /de yang sngon 'gro'i chos 'di rnams rgyun khyer du byed pa'i phyir thun gyi rnga sgras bskul ba'i tshe na'ang*/ phyi 'dul khrims kyi dge slong dge tshul dge bsnyen gang yin pa'i bslab pa dang mthun pas ldang ba/ nang smon 'jug gi byang chub sems bskyed dang ldan pas 'tshogs la/ dkon mchog gi rten la gus pas phyag 'tshal/ gsang ba sngags kyi rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' dang dam tshig la gnas pas bzhugs gral du lus bsam gtan gyi chos lnga dang ldan pas 'khod/ 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi dbang du ma song bar 'chi chos yang dag par byed do snyam pas zhal 'don gyi dus su yang rig pa ma yengs par sgra don dbyer med du mnyam par bzhag nas mi lus dal 'byor rnyed par dka' ba'i khrid kyi ngag 'don ni/ dang po bsgom bya dal 'byor rin chen 'di// thob dka' 'jig sla da res don yod bya// 'chi ba mi rtag pa ni/ gnyis pa snod bcud thams cad mi rtag cing*// sgos su 'gro ba'i tshe srog chu bur 'dra// nam 'chi cha med shi tshe ro ru 'gyur// de la chos kyi phan phyir brtson pas bsgrub// las rgyu 'bras ni/ gsum pa shi tshe rang dbang mi 'du bar// las ni bdag gir bya phyir sdig pa spangs// dge ba'i bya bas rtag tu 'da' bar bya// zhes bsam nyin re rang rgyud nyid la brtag

/ 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs ni/ bzhi pa 'khor ba'i gnas grogs bde 'byor sogs// sdug bsngal gsum gyis rtag tu mnar ba'i phyir// gsod sar khrid pa'i gshed ma'i dga' ston ltar// zhen 'khris bcad nas brtson pas byang chub sgrubs// zhes pas thun mong gi sngon 'gro bzhi dang*/ de nas rgyud snod du rung zhing ci byas thar pa'i lam du 'gro ba skyabs 'gro sems bskyed khrid kyi ngag 'don ni/ mdun du mtsho dbus dpag bsam ljon shing gi /sdong po rtsa ba gcig la yal ga lngar// gyes pa'i dbus mar seng khri pad+ma dang*// nyi zla'i steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma ni// rdo rje 'chang la bka' brgyud bla mas bskor// mdun du yi dam g.yas su sangs rgyas dang*// rgyab tu dam chos g.yon du dge 'dun dang*// gdan khri'i 'og tu chos skyong srung ma rnams// so so'i rigs mthun 'khor tshogs rgya mtshos bskor// mtsho mtha'i ne'u seng steng du mkha' khyab kyi// ma rgan thams cad 'khod par gyur pa las// rtse gcig yid kyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed gyur// bdag dang nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad phyogs bcu dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs yon tan phrin las thams cad gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bor gyur pa/ chos kyi phung po stong phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i 'byung gnas/ 'phags pa'i dge 'dun thams cad kyi mnga' bdag /drin can rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i dpal ldan bla ma dam pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// yi dam dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dam pa'i chos rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// 'phags pa'i dge 'dun rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs ye shes kyi spyan dang ldan pa rnams la skyabs su mchi'o// bdun nam nyer gcig gam ci nus brjod/

byang chub snying por mchis kyi bar// sangs rgyas rnams la skyabs su mchi// chos dang byang chub sems dpa' yi// tshogs la'ang de bzhin skyabs su mchi// ji ltar sngon gyi bde gshegs kyis// byang chub thugs ni bskyed pa dang*// byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa la// de dag rim bzhin gnas pa ltar// de bzhin 'gro la phan don du// byang chub sems ni bskyed bgyi zhing*// de bzhin du ni bslab pa la'ang*// rim pa bzhin du bslab par bgyi// lan gsum gyis byang sdom blang*/ de'i rjes su rang dbugs dbyung ba ni/ deng dus bdag tshe 'bras bu yod// mi yi srid pa legs par thob// de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sangs rgyas sras su bdag deng gyur// da ni bdag gis ci nas kyang*// rigs dang mthun pa'i las brtsams te// skyon med btsun pa'i rigs 'di la// rnyog par mi 'gyur de ltar bya// zhes dang*/ gzhan gzengs bstod pa ni/ bdag gis de ring skyobs pa thams cad kyi// spyan sngar 'gro ba bde gshegs nyid dang ni// bar du bde la mgron du bos zin gyis// lha dang lha min la sogs dga' bar gyis// zhes dang*/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ byang chub sems ni rin po che// ma skyes pa rnams skyes gyur cig /skyes pa nyams pa med pa dang*// gong nas gong du 'phel bar shog /byang chub sems dang mi 'bral zhing*// byang chub spyod la gzhol ba dang*// sangs rgyas rnams kyis yongs bzung zhing*// bdud kyi las rnams spong bar shog /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyis ni// 'gro don thugs la dgongs 'grub shog /mgon po yis ni gang dgongs pa// sems can rnams la de 'byor shog /sems can thams cad bde dang ldan gyur cig /ngan 'gro thams cad rtag tu stongs par shog /byang chub sems dpa' gang dag sar bzhugs pa// de dag kun gyi smon lam 'grub par shog / ces brjod par bya'o// de nas/ sems can thams cad bde ba dang bde ba'i rgyu dang ldan par gyur cig

/sdug bsngal dang sdug bsngal gyi rgyu dang bral bar gyur cig /sdug bsngal med pa'i bde ba dam pa dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig /nye ring chags sdang dang bral ba'i btang snyoms chen po la gnas par gyur cig / lan gsum gyis tshad med bzhi la blo byang*/ mtha' mar skyabs yul 'od zhu bdag dang 'dres/ ༈ / sdig sgrib dag par byed pa rdo rje sems dpa'i bsgom bzlas ni/ rang gi spyi bor pad zla'i gdan gyi steng*// bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' rgyan ldan dkar// zhal gcig phyag gnyis g.yas pas rdo rje dang*// g.yon pas dril bu 'dzin cing skyil krung bzhugs// thugs ka'i 'od zer gyis ye shes pa'i tshogs spyan drangs te bstim pas dkon mchog kun 'dus kyi ngo bor bsgoms la/ ngag tu/ bla ma rdo rje sems dpa' rang gzhan nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ gsol ba btab pas rdor sems kyi thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ gi mthar yi ge brgya pas bskor ba las bdud rtsi'i rgyun byung ba dang sku las bdud rtsi babs/ bdag gi tshangs bug nas zhugs lus gang bas sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad dag par gyur/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ badz+ra sa twa twe no pa/ tiṣ+ṭha dṛ ḍho me bha wa/ su to ṣ+yo me bha wa/ su po ṣ+yo me bha wa/ a nu rak+to me bha wa/ sarba sid+dhi m+me pra ya ts+tsha/ sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shri yaḥ ku ru hūm̐/ ha ha ha ha hoḥ bha ga wān/ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñca badz+rī bhā wa ma hā sa ma ya sa twa āḥ zhes yi ge brgya pa dang*/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa hūm̐/ zhes ci nus bzlas/ mthar thal mo snying gar sbyar te/ mgon po bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa yis// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa kye// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chags thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung gi tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/

rdo rje sems dpas bdag la dbugs dbyung zhing*// 'od zhu bdag la thim pas gnyis med gyur/ ༈ / tshogs gnyis rdzogs par byed pa'i maṇ+ḍal ni/ sgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal yod na de nyid ni/ bh+rāt+s+muṃ las gzhal yas khang du tshom bu lnga dkon mchog lngar bskyed de/ mdun gyi nam mkha'i dbus su bla ma dang*// mdun g.yas rgyab dang g.yon du rim pa bzhin// yi dam sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun dang*// rang rigs 'khor bcas gzhan yang gdan mtshams su// chos skyong rgya mtsho la sogs dkon mchog rnams// tshogs kyi zhing mchog dam pa bzhugs pa'i drung*// mchod pa'i maṇ+ḍal lag tu blangs nas/ rdul gtsang zhing dag par phyi ba'i tshe/ gzung 'dzin gyis bsdus pa'i rang gzhan gyi rgyud kyi sdig sgrib dag par bsam la/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa sogs yig brgya brjod/ tshig 'don zhing don gsal 'debs pa dang*/ tshom bu bkod nas 'bul ba rnams phyogs mthun bya ste/ oṃ badz+ra bhū mi āḥhūm̐/ gzhi rnam par dag pa dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi/ oṃ badz+ra re khe āḥhūm̐/ phyi lcags ri 'khor yug gi ra bas yongs su bskor ba'i dbus su ri'i rgyal po ri bo mchog rab/ shar lus 'phags po/ lho dzam+bu gling*/ nub ba lang spyod/ byang sgra mi snyan/ lus dang lus 'phags/ rnga yab dang rnga yab gzhan/ g.yo ldan dang lam mchog 'gro/ sgra mi snyan dang sgra mi snyan gyi zla/ rin po che'i ri bo/ dpag bsam gyi shing*/ 'dod 'jo'i ba/ ma rmos pa'i lo tog /'khor lo rin po che/ nor bu rin po che/ btsun mo rin po che/ blon po rin po che/ glang po rin po che/ rta mchog rin po che/ dmag dpon rin po che/ gter chen po'i bum pa/ sgeg mo ma/ phreng ba ma/ glu ma/ gar ma/ me tog ma/ bdug spos ma/ snang gsal ma/ dri chab ma/ nyi ma/ zla ba/ rin po che'i gdugs/ phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyal mtshan/ dbus su lha dang mi yi dpal 'byor phun sum tshogs pa ma tshang ba med pa/

rab 'byams rgya mtsho'i rdul gyi grangs las 'das pa mngon par bkod de/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs dang bcas pa rnams la 'bul bar bgyi'o// thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don du bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sa gzhi spos chus sogs dang*/ phyogs bcu dus gsum bzhugs pa yi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// bla ma rdo rje slob dpon dang*// yi dam lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas// dus gsum bde gshegs ma lus la// gling bzhi ri rab bcas pa dang*// gling bzhi bye ba phrag brgya dang*// bye ba 'bum dang dung phyur te// maṇ+ḍal gcig tu bsdus nas ni// mos blos gong ma rnams la 'bul// thugs rjes brtser dgongs bzhes su gsol// bzhes nas byin gyis brlab tu gsol// zhes dang*/ oṃ maṇ+ḍal pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ye āḥhūṃ// zhes pa gang rigs tshar ci nus su 'bul la rjes su/ mnyes byed maṇ+ḍal bzang po 'di phul bas// byang chub lam la bar chad mi 'byung zhing*// dus gsum bder gshegs dgongs pa rtogs pa dang*// srid par mi 'khrul zhi bar mi gnas shing*// nam mkha' mnyam pa'i 'gro ba sgrol bar shog / maṇ+ḍal grangs gsog pa yin na/ sa gzhi spos chus byugs shing me tog bkram// ri rab gling bzhi nyi zlas brgyan pa 'di// sangs rgyas zhing du dmigs te phul ba yis// 'gro kun rnam dag zhing la spyod par shog / ces rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar te/ sku gsum yongs rdzogs bla ma'i tshogs rnams la// phyi nang gsang gsum de bzhin nyid kyis mchod// bdag lus longs spyod snang srid yongs bzhes la// bla med mchog gi dngos grub stsal du gsol// phyag rgya chen po'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// phyag 'tshal ba dang mchod cing bshags pa dang*// rjes su yi rang bskul zhing gsol ba yi// dge ba cung zad bdag gis ci bsags pa// thams cad rdzogs pa'i byang chub chen por bsngo// bdag gzhan mkha' mnyam bdog pa kun phul nas// 'gro kun tshogs gnyis rab tu gang gyur te// tshogs zhing 'od zhu bdag dang ro mnyam gyur/

༈ / byin rlabs myur du 'jug par byed pa'i bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ khyad par dwags po bka' brgyud mos gus kyi bka' babs yin pas rjes 'jug rnams kyang byin rlabs 'di che bas the tshom med par sems rtse gcig pas/ spyi bor pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng du// rtsa ba'i bla ma rdo rje 'chang dbang po// rgyan ldan rdor dril 'dzin pa'i phyag rgya bsnol// rdo rje'i gdan bzhugs brgyud pa'i bla ma dang*// dkon mchog rgya mtsho mtho brtsegs khrom du tshogs// oṃ khyab bdag dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can// gnas med 'gro 'ong bral ba nam mkha' bzhin// gshegs dang 'byon pa'i mtshan ma mi mnga' yang*// chu zla bzhin du gar dmigs der snang ba// bdud dpung 'joms mdzad dpal ldan he ru ka /bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro 'khor dang bcas// bdag gi dad pas deng 'dir gsol 'debs na// dmigs med snying rje'i dbang gis 'dir gsal mdzod// 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// dus gsum sangs rgyas kun gyi ngo bo nyid// rang sems chos skur mngon sum ston mdzad pa// dpal ldan bla ma dam pa la phyag 'tshal// lus dang longs spyod yid kyis sprul pa yi// mchod pa kun gyis mchod cing bstod par bgyi// sngar byas sdig pa ma lus bshags par bgyi// sdig pa gzhan yang slan chad mi bgyid do// 'gro kun dge ba kun la rjes yi rang*// byang chub mchog gi rgyur ni bsngo bar bgyi// mya ngan mi 'da' bzhugs par gsol ba 'debs// theg mchog bla med chos 'khor bskor bar bskul// byams dang snying rje phyogs med 'byongs pa dang*// don dam lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes de// rgyal ba sras bcas rnams kyis rtogs pa ltar// bdag gis mngon sum rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// sgyu lus sprul skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// srog rtsol longs skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs*// rang sems chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// sku gsum dbyer med 'char bar byin gyis rlobs//

de nas phyag chen brgyud pa'i bla ma'i gsol 'debs ni/ dngos kun khyab bdag dpal ldan rdo rje 'chang*// sa bcu'i dbang phyug blo gros rin chen zhabs// 'phags yul grub pa'i gtso bo sa ra ha// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// chos nyid don gzigs 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*// phyag rgya che brnyes dpal ldan sha ba ri// snying po'i don gzigs jo bo mai tri pa// gsol ba 'debs so= rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i mnga' bdag lho brag pa// gangs can grub pa'i gtso bo mi la rje// rgyal bas lung bstan dpal ldan sgam po pa// gsol ba 'debs so= rgyal ba'i phrin las mnga' bdag dus gsum mkhyen// mthu stobs dbang phyug 'gro mgon ras chen zhabs// bskyed rdzogs mthar phyin rgyal sras spom brag pa// gsol 'debs so= gdul dka' 'dul mdzad dpal ldan karma pa// dngos grub gnyis brnyes grub chen o rgyan pa// 'dzam gling bstan pa'i mnga' bdag rang byung ba// gsol ba 'debs so= sngags rigs grub pa'i rgyal ba g.yung ston pa// 'dzam gling rgyan gyur rol pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs// gnas lugs don rtogs rtogs ldan mkha' spyod dbang*// gsol ba 'debs so= sa skyong gtsug rgyan chos rje de bzhin gshegs// mkhas pa'i dbang po rat+na bha dra'i zhabs// srid zhi'i dpal gyur mthong ba don ldan la// gsol ba 'debs so= rdo rje 'chang dngos 'jam dpal bzang po dang*// thugs rje'i bdag nyid dpal 'byor don grub zhabs// byin rlabs 'byung gnas chos grags rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so= mtshungs med bla ma grub chen chos kyi rje// bkra shis dpal 'byor zhes byar rab grags pa// bsam bzhin sku sprul chos grags dpal bzang la// gsol ba 'debs so= 'od dpag med mgon zhwa dmar cod pan 'dzin// rigs drug khyab bdag rgyal mchog karma pa// dkyil 'khor kun bdag dbang phyug rdo rje'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so=

dpag med 'od mtshan byin rlabs 'chang de dang*// e yig phyag rgya chen po seṅge'i khrir// waṃ yig 'gyur med chos dbyings rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so= sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i kha sbyor rdo rje sems// 'bras rgyud khyab bdag gar dbang rdo rje 'chang*// mchog gi sprul sku ye shes snying po'i zhabs// gsol ba 'debs so= bde stong dbyer med lhan skyes ye shes sku// gzhom med rdo rje'i gar gyis rnam rol pa// rgyal kun ngo bo ye shes rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so= zab dang rgya che'i chos tshul ji snyed par// rnam dpyod blo gros rgyas pa'i nus spobs can// tshul bzhin rtogs pa'i don gnyis lhun grub la// gsol ba 'debs so= khyab bdag gdod ma'i mgon po chos kyi dbyings// mi phyed rdo rje bzhi yi gar rol pa// kun mkhyen bla ma byang chub rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so= stong nyid mdzes mas mngon 'khyud rdo rje 'chang*// 'pho 'gyur bde ba 'dzag med lam bcings pa// rnal 'byor bstan pa'i nyin byed gang de la// gsol ba 'debs so= mi shigs snying po'i rang bzhin mngon gzigs nas// 'gyur med ye shes mchog la dbang bsgyur ba// 'jigs med bdud tshogs 'dul ba'i rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so= gdul bya'i khams dbang mos pa du ma'i ngor// de snyed thugs rje'i rol pa cir yang ston// dpal ldan mi pham chos grub rgya mtsho la/ gsol ba 'debs so=

karma pa bcu bzhi pas mdzad/ 'khor 'das mnyam nyid bde chen 'dus ma byas*// don dam chos sku'i rang zhal legs ston pa// rigs kun khyab bdag pad+ma nyin byed la// gsol ba 'debs so= yongs grub ye shes dgongs pa mkha' ltar dag /tshad med thugs rje'i snang ba kun la khyab// 'gro ba'i nyi ma theg mchog rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so= khyab bdag ston pa sku lnga'i rdo rje 'chang*// bde stong dbyer med phyag rgya chen po'i don// mngon gyur sangs rgyas yon tan rgya mtsho la// gsol ba 'debs so= khyab bdag gdod ma'i klong grol rdo rje 'chang*// dus gsum rgyal ba'i spyi gzugs karma ka /thugs rje tshad med mkha' khyab rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// byams mgon thugs klong rol pa khyab brdal dbyings// pad+ma'i rgyal tshab rgyal bstan 'gro ba'i mgon// zab gsal mtshungs med pad+ma dbang mchog la// gsol ba 'debs so= rig stong zag med chos dbyings rab 'byams dang*// bai ro'i rnam 'phrul sgrub brgyud bstan pa'i mgon// mtshungs med 'jam mgon mkhyen brtse'i 'od zer mchog /gsol ba 'debs so= dus gsum rgyal kun 'dus zhal chos kyi rje// rab 'byams dkyil 'khor gtso bo rdo rje 'chang*// rang byung khyab bdag rig pa'i rdo rje la// gsol ba 'debs so= 'jam mgon blo gros mtha' yas kyi gsung*/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i gnas lugs phyag rgya che// gnyug ma'i rang ngo sprod mdzad bka' drin can// sangs rgyas kun dngos rtsa ba'i bla ma la// gsol ba 'debs so= dngos grub gnyis stsol yi dam lha tshogs dang*// phrin las kun bdag chos skyong srung ma'i tshogs// bka' sdod dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs bcas la// gsol ba 'debs so lhan skyes ye shes stsol// de ltar gsol ba btab pa'i byin rlabs kyis// 'khor 'das dngos kun bsal bzhag spangs blangs dang*// yod med la sogs kun bral kun gyi gzhi// gnas lugs gzhi yi phyag rgya che rtogs shog

/rtogs bya rtogs byed rtogs pa ma dmigs shing*// bsgrib bya sgrib byed sgrib pa spangs med par// bgrod bya bgrod byed lam las rab 'das pa'i// lam gyi phyag rgya chen po mngon gyur shog /thob bya thob byed thob pa ma dmigs shing*// spangs thob gnyis med gzhi 'bras dbyer med pa// dngos bral dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin can// 'bras bu'i phyag rgya chen po mngon gyur shog ༈ /rdo rje 'chang chen tai lo nā ro dang*// mar pa mi la chos rje sgam po pa// dus gsum shes bya kun mkhyen karma pa// che bzhi chung brgyad brgyud pa 'dzin rnams dang*// 'bri stag tshal gsum dpal ldan 'brug pa sogs// zab lam phyag rgya che la mnga' brnyes pa'i// mnyam med 'gro mgon dwags po bka' brgyud la// gsol ba 'debs so bka' brgyud bla ma rnams// brgyud pa 'dzin no rnam thar byin gyis rlobs// zhen log sgom gyi rkang par gsungs pa bzhin// zas nor kun la chags zhen med pa dang*// tshe 'dir gdos thag chod pa'i sgom chen la// rnyed bkur zhen pa med par= mos gus sgom gyi mgo bor gsungs pa bzhin// man ngag gter sgo 'byed pa'i bla ma la// rgyun du gsol ba 'debs pa'i sgom chen la// bcos min mos gus skye bar= yengs med sgom gyi dngos gzhir gsungs pa bzhin// gang shar rtogs pa'i ngo bo so ma de// ma bcos de kar 'jog pa'i sgom chen la// bsgom bya blo dang bral bar= rnam rtog ngo bo chos skur gsungs pa bzhin// ci yang ma yin cir yang 'char ba la// ma 'gags rol par 'char ba'i sgom chen la// 'khor 'das dbyer med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// thun bzung ba'am/ mtshams kyi skabs su 'dir/ ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma sangs rgyas rin po che la gsol ba 'debs so// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma kun khyab chos kyi sku la gsol ba 'debs so// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma bde chen longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so// ma nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla ma thugs rje sprul pa'i sku la gsol ba 'debs so//

ma nam bzhi skor gyi bsnyen pa'am/ karma pa mkhyen no// sogs bya'o// yang na/ bla ma rin po che la gsol ba 'debs// bdag 'dzin blo yis thong bar byin gyis rlobs// dgos med rgyud la skye bar byin gyis rlobs// chos min rnam rtog 'gags par byin gyis rlobs// rang sems skye med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// 'khrul pa rang sar zhi bar byin gyis rlobs// snang srid chos skur rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// spro na/ bla ma rgyang 'bod gar dbang lnga pas mdzad pa'i/ pha rje btsun bla ma rin po che// zhes sogs dar drag la yun ring du snang ba 'gyur nges su bzhag de nas dbang blang ba ni/ dpal ldan bla ma dam pa khyed rnams kyis// bdag la smin byed dbang bzhi bskur du gsol// rgyud bzhi myur du smin par byin gyis rlobs// phrin las rnam bzhi'i dngos grub stsal du gsol// zhes pa'i gsol ba btab pa'i mod nyid la// 'khor rnams 'od zhu gtso bo'i sku la thim// gtso bo dkon mchog kun 'dus bdag nyid la// rnam pa bla ma dngos su gsal gyur pa'i// mdzod spu'i gnas nas 'od zer dkar po 'phros// rang gi dpral bar thim pas lus sgrib dag /bum pa'i dbang thob bskyed rim bsgom la dbang*// 'bras bu sprul sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// mgrin pa'i gnas nas 'od zer dmar po 'phros// rang gi mgrin par thim pas ngag sgrib dag /gsang ba'i dbang thob rtsa rlung bsgom la dbang*// longs spyod rdzogs sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// thugs ka'i gnas nas 'od zer sngon po 'phros// rang gi snying gar thim pas yid sgrib dag /sher dbang thob cing snyoms 'jug bsgom la dbang*// 'bras bu chos sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// gnas gsum 'od zer dkar dmar mthing gsum 'phros// gnas gsum la thim sgo gsum dri ma dag /bzhi pa'i dbang thob phyag chen bsgom la dbang*// ngo bo nyid sku 'grub pa'i skal ldan gyur// de nas bla ma 'od zhu rang la thim// rang gi lus ngag yid gsum bla ma yi// rdo rje gsum po dbyer med ro gcig cing*// khyer so gsum ldan lhun grub rang grol lo//

ces thun mong ma yin pa'i sngon 'gro bzhi dang*/ ༈ de rjes snang ba lam du khyer ba'i phyir rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bskyed rim rgyun khyer gyi rnal 'byor te/ de yang dkyil chog gzhung gi bdag bskyed dam/ yang na/ oṃ swa bhā wa sa bsang*/ stong pa'i ngang las khams gsum po// thams cad chos 'byung gzhal yas khang*// de dbus pad+mo ro yi steng*// rang sems hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros// 'phags mchod sems can don byas 'dus// yongs gyur bdag nyid rnal 'byor ma// chos sku nyag gcig zhal gcig pa// thabs shes zung 'jug phyag gnyis ma// bdud dpung 'joms mdzad khro gnyer can// mche gtsigs tshems kyis ma mchu mnan// dmar la g.yo zlum spyan gsum 'bar// dbu skra kham nag 'bar zhing grol// thod skam lnga yi dbu rgyan dang*// 'du byed dag pa'i rang bzhin gyi// thod rlon lnga bcu'i do shal 'phyangs// me tog dril bu g.yer khas brgyan// phyin drug rus rgyan phyag rgya lnga// rdo rje'i gri gug thod khrag bsnams// rus pa'i kha ṭāṃ gru mor brten// g.yon brkyang gar gyis rnam par rol// stong gsum khyab pa'i 'od 'bar ba'o// ha ri ni sa'i yi ge las// spyi bor rdo rje mkha' 'gro sngo// mgrin par rin chen mkha' 'gro ser// snying gar pad+ma mkha' 'gro dmar// lte bar las kyi mkha' 'gro ljang*// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma dang*// ral gris mtshan pa'i gri thod 'dzin// kha ṭāṃ 'dzin cing rim pa bzhin// so gnyis bcu drug brgyad dang ni// drug bcu rtsa bzhi'i 'khor gyis bskor// rang gi gsang gnas chos 'byung dbus// hrīḥdang mkha' 'gro bzhi'i thugs ka'i// yi ge bzhi las 'od zer 'phros// o rgyan gnas nas rnal 'byor ma// 'khor bcas spyan drangs nam mkhar bzhugs// de rnams sku las sku mang 'phros// lus thim bde dang drod nus bskyed// gsung las ā li kā li 'phros// ngag thim mthu dang nus pa bskyed// thugs las byang sems chu rgyun babs// yid thim bde stong ting 'dzin bskyed// lha rnams rang rang so sor thim// gnyis med rigs bdag dbu brgyan pa'o//

gtso mor rnam snang*/ 'khor lo bzhi'i lha mo rnams la rigs bzhis/ bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ gsang ba chos 'byung pad+ma 'dab bzhi'i dbus// hrīḥdang 'dab bzhir ha ri ni sa ste// hrīḥlas sngags phreng g.yon du 'khor ba las// don kun sgrub byed 'khor lo 'od 'bar ba'o// oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ha ri ni sa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes mi sdod pa gsum gyis gnad bskul te bsnyen pa ci nus bzla'o// thun gyi mthar rdzogs rim dang rjes spyod kyi rnal 'byor ni/ gsang gnas hrīḥyig 'od kyis snod bcud rten// 'od zhu bdag dang de yang hrīḥyig la// thim zhing thig le nā da de las kyang*// 'das pas dmigs su med pa stong nyid du// zhugs pas rang rig 'od gsal bcos min gyi// sems kyi ngo bo rig stong rjen par bud// ces ci gnas su phyag chen ngang la bzhag / rjes thob chu las nya bzhin rang nyid ni// bcom ldan 'das ma sgyu ma lta bu'i skus// 'khor ba ji srid de srid 'gro don mdzad// kha zas bsreg blug lus kyi dkyil 'khor mchod// nyal ba 'od gsal chos sku'i rnal 'byor gsal// bgo ba sngags kyi go cha mtshan dpes brgyan// 'gro 'dug dkyil 'khor ba la bskor ba phyogs// sad rmi gnyid dang chags pa'i gnas skabs rnams// sku bzhi'i rnal 'byor sgyu ma'i rnam par ro// zhes rje chos kyi dbang phyug gis stsal ba'o// bsngo ba smon lam ni/ dge 'dis 'gro ba ma lus rdo rje sems// rtag bde thabs shes sbyor bas 'chi med cing*// nang gi lam nas rdo rjer 'gro ba yi// sangs rgyas nyid kyi go 'phang stsol phyir bsngo// dge ba 'di yi myur du bdag /phyag rgya chen po 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /sangs rgyas sku gsum brnyes pa'i byin rlabs dang*// chos nyid mi 'gyur bden pa'i byin rlabs dang*// dge 'dun mi phyed 'dun pa'i byin rlabs kyis// ji ltar bsngo ba smon lam 'grub par shog

/ ces kyang brjod par bya'o// ces pa'ang rje btsun dbang phyug rdo rjes stsal ba'i phyag chen lhan cig skyes sbyor gyi khrid yig le tshan sogs kyi dgongs don ltar sngon 'gro bzhi sbyor gyi ngag 'don dang*/ rje chos kyi dbang phyug gis stsal ba'i rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i rgyun khyer bcas bla ma brgyud pa'i phyag gzhes ltar dkyus gcig tu bsdebs pa dge legs 'phel/ bkra shis dpal 'bar karma bka' brgyud bstan pa phyogs bcur rgyas pa'i 'dzam gling rgyan du shog// / sarba maṅga laṃ// // kha skong rnams gzhan nas dang spyi gzhung rnams gdams ngag mdzod las bshus pa dge legs 'phel/// /
